help:
O'So AI Relay links your PrestaShop shop to an AI running on this computer.

Usage: oso <command> [arguments] [--lang en|fr|es|de]

Commands:
  ui                     open the interface
  pair <shop> <code>     link a shop with the code shown in its back office
  ai <address>           set the address of the local AI and test it
  ai stop|start|free     stop or start your local AI, or free its memory
  run                    run the relay in this window
  install / uninstall    start or stop starting with this computer
  start / stop           start or stop the background relay
  status                 show the shop, the AI and the relay
  addtopath              install oso for your account and type it from any folder
  remove [--keep-ai]     uninstall oso from this computer (and the AIs it installed)
  llm list               list the models of the local AI
  llm test [model]       check that a model can call tools
  llm install <model>    download a model into Ollama
  llm setup ollama|lmstudio
                         install a local AI and a model, then test it
  llm remove ollama|lmstudio
                         uninstall an AI oso installed, with its models
  version                show the version
  help                   show this help
